        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
        print("Cancelling...")
        task.cancel()
        try:
            await task
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            print("Wrapper caught CancelledError")
            raise
    
    try:
        await wrapper()
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        print("Main caught CancelledError")

asyncio.run(main())
